name: dsh-plugin-local-llm
description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: run the agent on models served by your own machine. Registers lmstudio, ollama, strata, lemonade, and local-openai provider routes through an OpenAI-compatible chat-completions adapter, lists each engine in Settings as a configurable third-party provider with endpoint editing and model discovery, and adds the local_models tool.
author: umerkhalid204
